guides.title: Tabs, split panes, and windows
guides.summary: Keep a dozen documents open, put two side by side, and drag a tab wherever you want it.
guides.imageAlt: Clumsy showing a PDF with page thumbnails and the Document Map

guides.title: Command Palette and shortcuts
guides.summary: Every command is searchable, most have a key, and the right-click menu is yours to arrange.

guides.title: Find, Go Back, and the Document Map
guides.summary: Search with regular expressions, jump around a long file, and get back to where you were.

guides.title: Dark pages, scrolling, and zoom
guides.summary: Dark pages that leave photos alone, four ways to scroll, spreads, the Hand tool, and a caret for the keyboard.

guides.title: Highlights, notes, and comments
guides.summary: Highlight, underline, strike through, type on the page, draw, and leave comments and sticky notes.

guides.title: Shapes and stamps
guides.summary: Rectangles, clouds, and arrows for pointing at things. Review stamps and electrical symbols for drawings.

guides.title: Measuring drawings
guides.summary: Set a drawing's scale, measure lengths, paths, and areas, and send the totals to a spreadsheet.

guides.title: The Markups list
guides.summary: Every markup in one list, counted by subject, with review status and a summary for the spreadsheet.

guides.title: The tool chest
guides.summary: Save a tool with its style and a name, pick it in one click, and share the set with your team.

guides.title: Filling in forms
guides.summary: Tab through real form fields, drop checkmarks and dates on paper forms, and flatten the result.

guides.title: Signing your name
guides.summary: Type it, draw it, or photograph it once. It goes on the page as sharp ink, and stays saved.
guides.imageAlt: Clumsy placing a saved signature on a PDF

guides.title: Digital signatures
guides.summary: Check who signed a PDF and whether it still holds, and sign with a certificate you already have.

guides.title: Rearranging pages
guides.summary: Reorder, rotate, delete, extract, insert, and combine. All of it can be undone.

guides.title: Photos to PDF
guides.summary: Drop images on the window and each one becomes a page, right side up, at full quality.
guides.imageAlt: Clumsy with a new PDF made from dropped photos

guides.title: Comparing two PDFs
guides.summary: Two versions side by side with every added, removed, and changed word marked on both.
guides.imageAlt: Clumsy comparing two versions of a PDF side by side

guides.title: Compress, export, and print
guides.summary: Shrink a scan before emailing it, turn pages into images, and print with your markup on the page.

guides.title: Passwords
guides.summary: Set, change, or remove the password a PDF needs to open.

guides.title: Properties, attachments, and layers
guides.summary: See who made a PDF and with what, open the files inside it, and switch its layers on and off.

guides.title: Markdown files
guides.summary: Markdown opens formatted, with an outline and a minimap. The source is one shortcut away.
guides.imageAlt: Clumsy showing a rendered Markdown file with its outline and minimap

guides.title: Saving, reloading, and updates
guides.summary: What Clumsy writes to your file, what happens when another app changes it, and how updates arrive.
